properties.body:
Auditor finding FA-2014-07: fees were rounded half-up, which systematically
favoured us by a cent on .5 amounts. Contract clause 9.3 fixes the daily rate
(0.0005) and the cap (12.5% of the invoice amount).

Do NOT change these numbers without written sign-off from Finance.
properties.message: BILL-1432: late fees - 0.05%/day after grace period, capped at 12.5%, rounded half-even
properties.name: 64c96ce8

properties.body:
Compliance request LH-22: accounts under legal hold must not generate
reconciliation exceptions, because exceptions trigger automated correction
entries. Set -Dbilling.recon.includeLegalHold=true to include them again.
properties.message: BILL-4102: skip accounts on legal hold in the nightly reconciliation
properties.name: 27da25fd

properties.body:
The control requires an audit record that application code cannot skip, so it
is implemented as a trigger on tbl_ledger rather than in the DAO.
properties.message: Audit every ledger write with a database trigger (SOX control C-17) (#41)
properties.name: 24a85e05

properties.body:
The single query held a snapshot for several minutes once the ledger passed
40M rows and was killed by the statement timeout.
properties.message: export_ledger: paginate the export, the 02:30 run was timing out (BILL-4521)
properties.name: 88d4827e

properties.body: History before this point lives in the old Subversion server (decommissioned).
properties.message: Initial import of billing core from SVN r4812
properties.name: f5778901

properties.body: Signed off by Finance (ticket FIN-771) after the 2023 terms update.
properties.message: Raise late-fee grace period from 5 to 10 days (BILL-4388) (#203)
properties.name: 676ac713

properties.body:
Two payments for the same account within the same second both read the old
balance in Java and the second write won. The stored procedure locks the account
row and updates balance and ledger in a single transaction.
properties.message: Move balance update into sp_apply_payment to stop lost updates (BILL-901)
properties.name: c303dae8

properties.body:
Two enterprise customers have contracts that predate BILL-1432 and still
specify half-up rounding. Operations can enable LEGACY_ROUNDING for their
deployment without a release. Default stays half-even.
properties.message: Feature flags in the database; LEGACY_ROUNDING restores half-up fees (BILL-2677) (#88)
properties.name: e23ec310

properties.body:
Three escalation levels, tracked in tbl_invoice.dunning_level. Level 3 wording
was approved by Legal.
properties.message: Dunning reminders: Python job on top of v_open_invoices (BILL-3540) (#151)
properties.name: b0ae3954

properties.message: Extract lookup SQL into Queries constants; no behaviour change (#167)
properties.name: 12a83282

properties.body:
Invoices issued before 2013-04-01 carry the old VAT rate. Until they are all
settled, payments against them are multiplied by 1.0083 so the ledger shows the
new-rate equivalent. Temporary: remove once the last old-rate invoice is paid.
properties.message: BILL-688: scale payments on pre-2013 invoices for the VAT transition
properties.name: 13b84955

properties.body:
Compares paid invoices with posted ledger rows at 02:00 and records mismatches
in tbl_recon_exception. On the first of the month sp_close_period stamps the
open ledger rows with a new period.
properties.message: Nightly reconciliation job and month-end close (BILL-2101)
properties.name: 5f8ea330

properties.body:
The last old-rate invoice was settled in 2014. Tax2013Adjuster is no longer
called; leaving the class in place until Finance confirms no reprocessing is needed.
properties.name: db7f841c

properties.body:
Incident INC-5521: the payment gateway retried a callback after a timeout and
the payment was posted twice. applyPayment now refuses a gateway reference that
already exists in tbl_ledger, and the reference is stored with every entry.
properties.message: BILL-3312: idempotency guard for gateway callbacks (#132)
properties.name: 565bcfe8

-- Lock the account row first; two concurrent payments used to read the same balance.
    PERFORM 1 FROM tbl_account WHERE id = p_account FOR UPDATE

properties.name: UPDATE tbl_invoice
properties.sql: UPDATE tbl_invoice SET dunning_level = %s WHERE id = %s

properties.name: UPDATE tbl_account
properties.sql: UPDATE tbl_account SET balance = balance - ? WHERE id = ?

properties.name: UPDATE tbl_account
properties.sql: UPDATE tbl_account SET balance = balance - p_amount WHERE id = p_account

properties.name: SELECT tbl_ledger
properties.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_ledger WHERE gateway_ref = ?

properties.sql: UPDATE tbl_invoice SET status = 'PAID', paid_on = CURRENT_DATE WHERE id = ?

properties.sql: SELECT id, account_id, amount, status, issued_on, due_on FROM tbl_invoice WHERE id = ?

properties.name: SELECT v_open_invoices
properties.sql: SELECT id, account_id, account_name, amount, due_on, dunning_level FROM v_open_invoices WHERE due_on < %s AND dunning_level < %s

properties.name: SELECT tbl_account
properties.sql: SELECT id, name, balance, legal_hold FROM tbl_account WHERE id = ?

properties.name: INSERT tbl_ledger
properties.sql: INSERT INTO tbl_ledger (account_id, invoice_id, amount, kind, gateway_ref) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)

properties.name: SELECT tbl_invoice, tbl_ledger …
properties.sql: SELECT i.id, i.amount, COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) AS posted FROM tbl_invoice i LEFT JOIN tbl_ledger l ON l.invoice_id = i.id WHERE i.status = 'PAID' AND i.account_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM tbl_account WHERE legal_hold = 1) GROUP BY i.id, i.amount HAVING i.amount <> COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0)

properties.name: CALL sp_apply_payment
properties.sql: {call sp_apply_payment(?, ?, ?, ?)}

properties.name: SELECT tbl_ledger, tbl_account
properties.sql:
SELECT l.id, l.account_id, a.name, l.invoice_id, l.amount, l.kind, l.posted_at
FROM tbl_ledger l
JOIN tbl_account a ON a.id = l.account_id
WHERE l.posted_at >= %s AND l.posted_at < %s
ORDER BY l.id
 LIMIT %s OFFSET %s

properties.name: INSERT tbl_recon_exception
properties.sql: INSERT INTO tbl_recon_exception (invoice_id, expected, posted, detected_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

)

)
properties.name: tbl_period

properties.ddl:
CREATE TABLE tbl_invoice (
    id            BIGINT PRIMARY KEY,
    account_id    BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES tbl_account (id),
    amount        NUMERIC(14, 2) NOT NULL,
    status        VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'OPEN',
    issued_on     DATE NOT NULL,
    due_on        DATE NOT NULL,
    paid_on       DATE,
    dunning_level SMALLINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
)
properties.name: tbl_invoice

properties.ddl:
CREATE TABLE tbl_account (
    id          BIGINT PRIMARY KEY,
    name        VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    balance     NUMERIC(14, 2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    legal_hold  SMALLINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at  TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
)
properties.name: tbl_account

properties.ddl:
CREATE TABLE tbl_recon_exception (
    id          BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    invoice_id  BIGINT NOT NULL,
    expected    NUMERIC(14, 2) NOT NULL,
    posted      NUMERIC(14, 2) NOT NULL,
    detected_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
)
properties.name: tbl_recon_exception

properties.ddl:
CREATE TABLE tbl_feature_flag (
    name        VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,
    enabled     SMALLINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    changed_at  TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
)
properties.name: tbl_feature_flag

properties.ddl:
CREATE TABLE tbl_ledger (
    id          BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    account_id  BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES tbl_account (id),
    invoice_id  BIGINT REFERENCES tbl_invoice (id),
    amount      NUMERIC(14, 2) NOT NULL,
    kind        VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
    gateway_ref VARCHAR(64),
    period_id   INTEGER,
    posted_at   TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
)
properties.name: tbl_ledger

properties.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_open_invoices AS
SELECT i.id, i.account_id, a.name AS account_name, i.amount, i.due_on, i.dunning_level
FROM tbl_invoice i
JOIN tbl_account a ON a.id = i.account_id
WHERE i.status = 'OPEN'
